name: dsh-session-migrator
description: Move old sessions out of the DSH session list and restore them later: workspace/month grouped lists, Git branch and parent display, notes/todo protection, configurable archive directory, multi-select restore, and DSH archive-state preservation. | 把旧会话迁移出 DSH 会话列表并在需要时恢复：按工作区/月份分组的列表、Git 分支与父会话显示、备注/待办保护、可配置迁移目录、多选恢复、保留 DSH 归档状态。
